title: Online LGBTQ+ Identity Support UK | Therapy with Roy
description: Online support for LGBTQ+ identity with Roy Lam, MBACP: coming out, relationships and family. UK-based, worldwide. Sessions £80. Free consultation.

hero.eyebrow: Online therapy for LGBTQ+ identity · UK-based, available worldwide
hero.subtitle: A confidential, non-judgemental space to explore your identity, your relationships and your place in your family and community, at your own pace.

problem.label: Identity and belonging
problem.title: Being fully yourself, at your own pace
paragraphs: Whether you are questioning, coming out, or have known who you are for years, the pressure does not always ease just because you have a name for it. There can be the fear of how family, friends or colleagues will react, the weight of keeping parts of your life private, or a sense of grief for time that felt out of reach.

You do not need to have it all worked out, and you do not need to explain yourself in order to start. This is a place to think out loud, to be heard without judgement, and to decide what you share, with whom, and when.
problem.quote: “I look forward to providing my support to you and helping you reflect, connect and grow.”

steps.title: Free Consultation
steps.text: Book a free 15–30 minute call. We’ll talk about what’s brought you here and whether we’re a good fit. No commitment required.

steps.title: Begin Sessions
steps.text: We meet online via Google Meet, Monday to Friday, 9am–7pm London time, from wherever you feel comfortable and private. Sessions are 50 minutes, and you set the pace.

steps.title: Reflect & Grow
steps.text: Over time, build self-acceptance, think through what you want from your relationships and your family, and find your own way forward.

approach.title: Respect for your story
paragraphs: After my Master in Social Sciences (Counselling) at the University of Hong Kong in 2017, I volunteered as a counsellor working with clients facing LGBT-related concerns, family difficulties, relationship challenges, depression and anxiety.

I work in an integrative way, drawing on Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Emotion-Focused Therapy and Bowen’s Family Systems Theory, always with a warm, genuinely non-judgemental presence. Your pace, your words and your choices lead the work.

Originally from Hong Kong, I moved to the UK in 2021, and I understand how identity can sit alongside cultural and family expectations. I am a registered member of the BACP (No. 397064) and offer sessions in English and Cantonese.
